prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-09
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 816ed53d5c034fec
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Fetch test with 256-word NOP mem traps immediately with `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` and `tohost: FAIL 0xdead` instead of clean fetch progress with no trap. instr_trap is stuck at 1 even for valid instr_addi. Root cause at picorv32.v:679 where `assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{...}` uses OR, so when CATCH_ILLINSN/WITH_PCPI is set it forces trap on every instruction; it must be AND to trap only on illegal instructions.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 816ed53d5c034fec in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
